docs_derived: register(ctx) registers hooks; callbacks receive keyword arguments and should accept **kwargs.
Explicit session, turn, API-attempt and tool-call IDs are opaque; do not parse compound IDs.
on_session_end ends a turn/run; on_session_finalize and on_session_reset delimit session lifetime.
Approval hooks are observer-only; session_key is not guaranteed to identify a session_id or request.
pre_llm_call and pre_tool_call have behavior-affecting return conventions; Coucou must return None and leave inputs unchanged.
Even sanitized request/response/error bodies, child goals/summaries and environment/terminal metadata exceed Coucou's allowlist.
